scientific_integrity: The displayed proof combines exact Artin–Schreier trace computations, the genus formula, equality in the Weil bound, and an independent all-degree inequality. Finite verification programs reproduce examples but are not substituted for the universal proof. Independent mathematical review has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The explicit genus-four Artin–Schreier curve and the sharp threshold concern the pair (q,g)=(4,4) only; no uniqueness or wider field classification. A matching Weil polynomial occurs in a previously published candidate list, so its polynomial expression is not presented as a new candidate. An older explicit realization remains a possible priority risk.
title: An explicit genus-four Artin–Schreier curve proves the exact closed-point threshold \(\rho(4,4)=4\)
